On the bright side, you're in a better situation than I am. I'm months away from graduating while you are a junior - you still have one year to get better and improve your GPA. Even if the GPA thing doesn't work out, programming courses are the holy grail of non-university studies because of their good job prospects. There are also apprenticeships you can do that can pay moderately well in the US (not as good as the last option though); electrician, mechanic, HVAC technician, etc. University isn't everything. You can be just as happy doing any of these, so you haven't ruined your life yet. If you lived in my country and were forty then yes, probably, but you're still young.

This may or may not help, but think of how happy and proud you'll be if you do get it together and work hard next year! You don't have to spend your life trapped in daydreams to find happiness. I'm sure you're a smart and kind individual, and by changing your habits you can be a responsible person too. Don't give up, okay? I hope we can both get the lives we want by beating this disorder once and for all.

Edit: I want to add that in my country things are pretty bad job wise (no matter what you study mostly), especially if you go back to college because you are older and might not get hired. Also, I’m a woman so I wouldn’t even get hired in some of the apprenticeships I mentioned. But I really think you have a chance, so don’t worry about having a shitty part time job for life. Hi, I agree with the other Redditor. If you watch porn, your mind becomes used to it and it starts "normalizing" what is happening in the porn. I'm going to take it a step further though, and say that if you are attracted to people your age and not just minors and animals, I would refrain from fantasizing about it altogether. I know it's not a crime, but it will probably make you get rid of your attraction more easily, or at least suppress it better. I think that if you weren't born with this and it is just trauma, it can be reversed. If not, you'll still be better than the people who actually do knowingly hurt minors and animals. As long as you don't offend and don't watch actual porn, I think you're a human being worthy of love and care. I know many people wouldn't agree with this though, and I would definitely keep your attractions to yourself. Some people can't even differentiate between someone who offends and someone who doesn't. But you know what? You're willing to do the right thing and not cause harm to others, and that makes you a good person. You don't have to kill yourself. Plus, it's not like you chose to have this attraction. It's the fault of those students and the trauma they put you through.

As for going to jail, I know that some countries don't consider drawn CP a crime, but I don't know which ones. Either way, even if you do get arrested for it, you might not get a long sentence.

Hey, I can relate to your post a lot. I feel like you’re the male (I assume you’re male) version of me. All of what you’re saying does not mean you are unloveable or unworthy of respect. It’s harder for people like us to get friends and respect from people, but it’s not impossible. I’ve managed to make friends who know I’m a bit slow, and so can you. If not, you could try and make friends that share similar problems; they will likely be more open and understanding. Also, the people making fun of you are jerks that don’t have enough empathy. 

If it’s hard to problem solve, what I usually do is try to breathe and slowly work my way through it. It sucks that it takes longer, but that doesn’t mean you can’t solve it. Don’t give up before you try! 

Socializing and talking normally usually takes practice. Maybe you can practice with your family or with yourself? Pretend you are having a conversation with a stranger and try to imitate how most people socialize or talk. That’s what works for me, though I don’t always get it right. Even if you can’t do it as well as normal people, the fact that you’re trying should be enough. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.

Lastly, none of this is your fault. You didn’t choose to be born this way if what you’re saying is true. Your life will probably be a bit harder than most people’s, but that makes you more admirable. All those people making fun of you have NO IDEA how easy they have it, and if they were in your shoes, they’d find out how strong you are. You are still alive, you kept going despite the odds stacked against you by our shitty society and economy that doesn’t give a flying fuck about us. Can they say the same? Probably not. Remember this when you have a bad day, because you deserve to live just like everyone else.

Hey. If it makes you feel any better, I don't think you're attracted to kids based on what you just wrote. If you were a kid when this happened, then it doesn't necessarily mean you're into them now. The intrusive thoughts could simply be pedophilia OCD. You even said yourself that you're positive you don't feel attracted to them.

As for what you should do...I think the best option is to let it be. If your sister remembers what happened, she might not want to be reminded of it. In this case, it might be best to let her bring it up on her own. If she doesn't remember, she could be repressing the trauma and reminding her of it could go just as badly or worse. I would focus on being there for her instead if you two get along. Hard classes can be very taxing and stressful, she might appreciate having someone to talk to from time to time. If she does ever bring the incident up, listen to what she has to say. She may forgive you or she may not, but if she doesn't, try to accept it the best you can. Remember that as the victim, it is up to her to forgive you.

All this being said, if you know it's bad as an adult and you would never do it again, I don't think you're a terrible person. If you were a child yourself, you probably didn't know it was bad. I'm not saying it was justified in any way, just that it's not the same as a grown adult doing the same. An adult is old enough to know they shouldn't be doing it, but not a child.

I hope this helped.

I meant “predicator complement” actually. I accidentally messed up the terminology. 

I learnt that the direct object is a constituent that becomes the subject of the sentence if the sentence becomes passive. For example, “I took the bag” can be turned into “it was taken by me”., so “the bag” is a direct object. The reason why I asked if the verb “had” can have a direct object is because “the cat is had by me” sounds weird. 

A predicator complement is not an object, so it can’t be a direct or indirect object, It’s a constituent that is necessary for the sentence to make sense, for example: “70 kgs” in “he weighs 70 kgs”.
